description.value: You trigger an electromagnetic pulse device, frying circuitry in a 20-foot radius centered on yourself. Each creature and unattended electronic device in the area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d6 ion damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one; constructs and devices that fail also shut down and are disabled for 1 minute.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 3
